title: Finite finitely presented ring extensions preserve finite presentation of modules
statement: Let $R\to S$ be a finite and finitely presented homomorphism of commutative rings, and let $M$ be an $S$-module. Then $M$ is finitely presented as an $R$-module if and only if it is finitely presented as an $S$-module [def-sc-finitely-presented-module].
